upstream.description: Free, Open Source, Self-Hosted WhatsApp API Gateway

classification.analysis: OpenWA is a self-hosted, open-source WhatsApp API Gateway built on NestJS/TypeScript that exposes a REST API for sending/receiving text, media, reactions, groups, and channels over WhatsApp, using reverse-engineered clients (whatsapp-web.js and Baileys) rather than Meta's official Cloud API. It has a pluggable architecture (SQLite/PostgreSQL, Local/S3, Redis cache), a React management dashboard, webhooks with HMAC signing, multi-session support, official plugins for Chatwoot/Typebot, and n8n community nodes for workflow automation. Aimed at developers and automation hobbyists who need WhatsApp bot/notification infrastructure without vendor lock-in, with explicit documentation warning about account-ban risk since it's unofficial and not suited for regulated/compliance-sensitive deployments.

use_cases.title: Self-host a WhatsApp API to send automated notifications or OTPs
Build a WhatsApp chatbot integrated with n8n or Chatwoot
Run multiple WhatsApp sessions with webhook events for a support tool
